params.name: Cursor
params.description: Base64 keyset pagination cursor. Pass the `EndCursor` (forward) or `StartCursor` (backward) from the previous response's `Metadata.Pagination`. Omit on the first request.

params.name: PageSize
params.description: Number of items to return per page. Must be a positive integer, capped at 200.

params.name: Direction
params.description: Pagination direction relative to the supplied cursor.

params.name: SortOrder
params.description: Sort order for the selected `SortField`.

params.name: SortField
params.description: Field to sort by. One of: PayoutDate, PublisherID, CreatedAt.

params.name: PublisherID
params.description: Filters payouts by creator (publisher) id.

params.name: DivisionID
params.description: Comma-separated list of division ids to filter by. Each entry must be a positive integer or the literal `null` (payouts with no division).

params.name: DateStart
params.description: Returns payouts with a payout date on or after this ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

params.name: DateEnd
params.description: Returns payouts with a payout date on or before this ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

params.name: IncludePayoutStatus
params.description: Comma-separated list of payout statuses to include. Mutually exclusive with `ExcludePayoutStatus`. `NO ACCOUNT` is not accepted as a filter value. Valid values: READY, UNPAYABLE, BELOW MINIMUM, SUBMITTED, PROCESSING, SENT, SUBMISSION FAILED, PAID, CANCELLED, FAILED.

params.name: ExcludePayoutStatus
params.description: Comma-separated list of payout statuses to exclude. Mutually exclusive with `IncludePayoutStatus`. `NO ACCOUNT` is not accepted as a filter value.

params.name: Currency
params.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 4217 currency codes to filter by.

params.name: PublisherIsPayable
params.description: Filters by whether the creator is currently payable.

params.name: ExcludeCancelledPayouts
params.description: When `true`, cancelled payouts are omitted from the response.

items.docs:
Returns a paginated list of the authenticated partner's payouts in the
creator view. Payouts are referenced exclusively by their customer-facing
`PayoutID`; the internal payout identifier is never exposed.

items.docs:
Returns a paginated list of the authenticated partner's payables.
Payables are referenced by their customer-facing `PayableID`;
the internal payable identifier is never exposed. Filters are additive
(combined with AND).

info.name: Get creators' payment info collection status

params.name: Cursor
params.description: Base64 keyset pagination cursor. Pass the `EndCursor` (forward) or `StartCursor` (backward) from the previous response's `Metadata.Pagination`. Omit on the first request.

params.name: PageSize
params.description: Number of items to return per page. Must be a positive integer, capped at 200.

params.name: Direction
params.description: Pagination direction relative to the supplied cursor.

params.name: SortOrder
params.description: Sort order for the selected `SortField`.

params.name: SortField
params.description: Field to sort by. Currently only PublisherId is supported.

params.name: PayableStatus
params.description: Filters by whether the creator is payable (eligible to be paid).

params.name: PaymentInfoStatus
params.description: Comma-separated list of payment-info statuses to filter by. Valid values: Not Submitted, Received, Invalid.

params.name: ApprovalStatus
params.description: Filters by approval state. `true` (approved), `false` (not approved) or `null` (no approval required).

items.docs:
Returns a paginated list describing, per creator, whether payment info,
tax info and approval have been collected. Replaces the legacy Creator
Payment Info Status report and lets you identify creators whose payouts
are blocked pending information.
